reason: I grab my energy cans at the petrol station when I'm driving or before training, I'm not ordering a 12-pack online and walking to a Zásilkovna box for a drink. If I can't pick it out of a fridge at Shell or OMV, it doesn't exist for me.
objection: Where can I actually buy it? Only online or at some cafés I never go to, and 54 crowns a can is more than a Monster at the pump on my money.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it cold in the fridge at petrol stations I stop at, or at GymBeam/Vilgain next to my pre-workout, so I can try one can for around 40 CZK.
